name: Libraries Provider
description: Lets modules and themes declare how their external front-end libraries are served (jsDelivr CDN or local /libraries), with per-library version, minification, variant, replacement and custom-option overrides via hook_library_info_alter.

suggests.sassphp (PHP extension): Required only for the custom-options (SASS variable compilation) feature; see https://github.com/absalomedia/sassphp

project_description: Libraries provider relieves themes and modules from hard-coding where their third-party front-end assets are loaded from. A module or theme adds a `libraries_provider` key to a library definition in its *.libraries.yml (declaring an npm_name, default source, minification policy, variants, replacements). The module then rewrites those library definitions at runtime via hook_library_info_alter (a core_event_dispatcher LibraryInfoAlterEvent subscriber), so the site can switch each library between the jsDelivr CDN and the local /libraries filesystem, pick a version, choose minified/normal serving, select a variant, or have one library replace another. Version lists come from the jsDelivr data API (npm packages) or a local package.json. The optional libraries_provider_ui submodule exposes a 'library' config entity list at /admin/structure/libraries where admins with the 'administer libraries' permission edit these overrides. Custom options (currently SASS variable overrides compiled with the sassphp extension) are supported for locally-served libraries.
